title: Trace explorer v2 user-visible strings must go through react-intl and the en.json catalog
answers: hardcoded English text in the trace explorer span links tab
trace explorer labels not translated or localized
how do I add a new string to the v2 trace explorer UI
why are my new trace explorer strings missing from en.json
body:
Convention: user-facing text in the redesigned (v2) trace explorer is rendered through react-intl, not as bare JSX text. Sibling tabs wrap labels in FormattedMessage; copy-tooltip strings use intl.formatMessage.
Where: mlflow/server/js/src/shared/web-shared/model-trace-explorer/v2/right-pane/ModelTraceExplorerLinksTab.tsx:SpanLinkEntry (the labels, buttons, and See more/See less toggle), with siblings ModelTraceExplorerAttributesTab and ModelTraceExplorerEventsTab as the reference pattern.
Each new defaultMessage/description pair must appear as a hashed key in mlflow/server/js/src/lang/default/en.json. Regenerate it with yarn i18n; do not hand-edit the hashes.
What breaks if skipped: the string is not extracted, so it is not localized and yarn i18n:check fails on a stale catalog.
applies: Any new or changed visible text in mlflow/server/js/src/shared/web-shared/model-trace-explorer/v2, including span link UI.
says: Buttons and labels in the trace explorer link tab remain in English when localized.
Text and tooltips in the redesigned trace details side panel are not being translated.
Translate all buttons, toggles, and tooltips inside the trace explorer span links panel.
The expanded trace view displays unlocalized English text for the see more button toggle.
